article_framing_rejections.headline: St. Lucie County detectives search Fort Pierce home in $7 million Southern Truss fraud case

lead_independence.headline: St. Lucie County detectives search Fort Pierce home in $7 million Southern Truss fraud case
lead_independence.lead: The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office confirmed Tuesday that deputies served a search warrant at the home of Laura Beth Grasso near Sunset Boulevard as part of the ongoing investigation into the Southern Truss fraud case. Crime scene investigators were seen outside the home. Grasso was arrested July 16 along with Sheri Lynn Harrs and Tina Marie Mejia following what the sheriff's office described as a years-long scheme targeting Southern Truss Companies. Grasso has pleaded not guilty to the charges. Investigators allege Grasso, who worked as the company's bookkeeper and comptroller, used her administrative access to bypass financial controls and funnel millions of dollars out of the business. Detectives say the money was spent on luxury vehicles, vacations, designer goods, jewelry and other personal expenses. Grasso faces charges of first-degree grand theft of $100,000 or more, organized fraud of $50,000 or more, conducting an enterprise through a pattern of racketeering activity and money laundering of $100,000 or more. Her bond was set at a combined $1.15 million across the four charges. Prosecutors have asked a judge to hold a hearing on the legitimacy and source of any bail premium or collateral before allowing Grasso to be released from the St. Lucie County Jail. Harrs and Mejia each face charges of grand theft, organized fraud and racketeering.

article_framing_rejections.headline: Search warrant executed at Fort Pierce home tied to $7 million Southern Truss fraud case

lead_independence.headline: Search warrant executed at Fort Pierce home tied to $7 million Southern Truss fraud case
lead_independence.lead: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office deputies executed a search warrant Tuesday morning at the Fort Pierce home of Laura Beth Grasso in the Indian River Estates neighborhood near Sunset Boulevard. Crime scene investigators were seen outside the home as part of the ongoing investigation into the Southern Truss fraud case. Grasso was arrested July 16 along with Sheri Lynn Harrs and Tina Marie Mejia following what the sheriff's office described as a years-long scheme targeting Southern Truss Companies. Grasso has pleaded not guilty to the charges.

article_framing_rejections.headline: Father arrested in Virginia in connection with Fort Pierce infant malnutrition death

lead_independence.headline: Father arrested in Virginia in connection with Fort Pierce infant malnutrition death
lead_independence.lead: The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office announced Tuesday that Jason Gunter, 45, was taken into custody by the United States Marshals Service at his home in Mechanicsville, Virginia. Detectives had obtained an arrest warrant for Gunter in connection with the death of his 3-month-old son. He has been charged with felony child neglect causing great harm and is awaiting extradition to St. Lucie County.
